label: relativeIgnored: relative fields are read as absolute, so +400 makes a 400 px canvas
find: relative ? CanvasSize(width: old.width + width, height: old.height + height) : CanvasSize(width: width, height: height)

label: cropNeedsBothSides: the crop note shows only when both sides shrink
modeSwitchResets: switching to relative keeps the absolute number, so the size jumps
heightClampDropped: the height field takes any value, so a side can reach 0 or pass maxSide
